name: fillet-past-a-hole
why: The hole-rim part with the fillet at 8 mm, its foot past the far rim, so the whole hole lies under the fillet. OpenCASCADE's cut-then-fillet returns a solid with the hole's rim left dangling in the cylinder's face (one free edge); built fillet-then-cut the hole runs through the fillet, 13 faces, the harness's 8057.336.
